summary: Completed comprehensive testing of RBAC (Role-Based Access Control) system. All 20 backend API tests passed. Frontend UI testing confirmed all features working: Role Management page loads correctly, Edit Role sheet with CRUD checkboxes and Data Scope dropdowns functional, Permissions Preview Panel working with user search and effective permissions display.
critical_code_review_comments: WebSocket connection errors observed in console (non-blocking) - may want to investigate WebSocket stability
seed_data_creation: Test roles created and cleaned up during tests
context_for_next_testing_agent: RBAC system fully functional. Backend APIs tested: GET/POST/PUT/DELETE /api/rbac/roles, GET /api/rbac/modules, GET /api/rbac/presets, GET /api/rbac/users/{user_id}/permissions. Frontend tested: Role Management page at /admin/roles, Edit Role sheet with CRUD checkboxes and Data Scope dropdowns, Permissions Preview Panel with user search.

backend_apis.GET /api/rbac/roles: PASS - Returns list of 16 roles with required fields (id, name, code, module_access, module_permissions, user_count)
backend_apis.GET /api/rbac/roles/{role_id}: PASS - Returns single role with enriched data
backend_apis.POST /api/rbac/roles: PASS - Creates new role with CRUD permissions
backend_apis.GET /api/rbac/modules: PASS - Returns 21 modules in 7 categories (core, collaboration, operations, business, hr_finance, analytics, admin)
backend_apis.GET /api/rbac/presets: PASS - Returns 4 presets (viewer, editor, manager, admin) with CRUD and data_scope fields
backend_apis.GET /api/rbac/users/{user_id}/permission: PASS - Returns effective permissions with roles, modules, permissions, is_admin flags

frontend_ui.role_management_page: PASS - Loads at /admin/roles with header, stats cards (Total Roles: 16, System Roles: 0, Total Modules: 21, Categories: 7), roles table
frontend_ui.roles_table: PASS - Shows 16 roles with columns: Role, Modules, Users, Admin Access, Status, Actions
frontend_ui.edit_role_sheet: PASS - Opens on role row click, shows Role Name, Role Code, Description, Administrative Access toggles
frontend_ui.crud_checkboxes: PASS - Create, Read, Update, Delete checkboxes visible and functional for each module
frontend_ui.data_scope_dropdown: PASS - Shows options: Own, Own + Assigned, Team, Department, All
frontend_ui.module_categories_accordion: PASS - Core, Collaboration, Operations, Business, HR & Finance, Analytics, Admin categories expandable
frontend_ui.preview_permissions_button: PASS - Opens User Permissions Preview dialog
frontend_ui.user_search: PASS - Search input filters users by name/email
frontend_ui.user_permissions_display: PASS - Shows Assigned Roles, Module Access, Module Permissions Detail sections
